request: Analyze GSE266883 for PMID 38982049 (Self-powered triboelectric-responsive microneedles with controllable release of optogenetically engineered extracellular vesicles for intervertebral disc degeneration repair.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of nucleus pulposus (NP) tissue/cells; rat L4-L5 IVDs (Sham, LSI, LSI-E; n=3 each) plus a separate human normal vs degenerated NP series (n=3 each) in the same GEO series

grp: LSI (lumbar spinous process resection, no exercise)

final.sample_inclusion: rat samples only (9) for the exercise question; the 6 human IVDD/Normal samples address degeneration, not exercise, and are on a different matrix/organism
final.primary_estimand: effect of treadmill exercise on NP transcriptome in lumbar-instability rats: LSI-E vs LSI (Fig. 2G-J, S2.1.p2)
planned_contrasts: LSI-E vs LSI (primary; S2.1.p2, Fig. 2G-J; paper reports GO/GSEA, no DEG count)
LSI-E vs Sham (secondary; S2.1.p2, Supplementary Fig. 2A; no DEG count)
final.paper_method: not stated (DEG method unreported; GSEA 4.2.3 with NES |>1|, p<0.05, FDR q<0.25 - S4.3.p2, S4.21.p1)

paper_threshold.source_locator: not stated for DEGs; S4.3.p2 gives only GSEA cutoffs

final.paper_results: LSI-E vs LSI DEGs enriched for immune/inflammatory GO terms; GSEA: cytosolic DNA-sensing pathway, inflammatory response, NF-kB signaling up in LSI-E (Fig. 2G-J, S2.1.p2)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.1.p2: L4-L5 IVDs from sham, LSI and LSI-E rats were RNA-sequenced; DEGs LSI-E vs Sham and LSI-E vs LSI analysed by GO/KEGG/GSEA. Fig 2 legend: n=3 per group for RNA-seq. S4.20.2.p1 describes treadmill exercise. No DEG test or threshold is reported anywhere (S4.21.p1, S4.25.p1).

final.checks: S10.p1 names GSE266883; GEO samples GSM8255521-29 are Sham/LSI/LSI-E rat NP RNA-seq matching Fig 2A design (n=3 each); matrix GSE266883_Sham_LSI_LSI_E_RPKM.txt.gz columns Sham_1-3, LSI_1-3, LSI_E_1-3 match metadata description field

ownership.reasoning: Data availability statement S10.p1 deposits GSE266883; contact institute Wuhan Union Hospital matches authors.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns equal the token before the comma in metadata 'description' (e.g. 'LSI_E_1,Sham_LSI_LSI_E_RPKM.txt'); group derived from the same token and cross-checked with characteristics_ch1.2.treatment (Sham operation/LSI/LSI-E). Human samples excluded. The 6 human samples (GSM8255515-20) have no column in this rat matrix and drop out at alignment; not part of the exercise question.

matrix.reasoning: File name says RPKM; GEO data_processing: 'Read Per Kilobase of exon per Megabase of library size (RPKM) were calculated'; values are non-integer (integer fraction 0.16) with median 1.8. No raw counts deposited. Paper does not state its DE input.

final.analysis_type: multi-group (3 levels), one model, planned pairwise contrasts

design.reasoning: Primary estimand is exercise within LSI rats (LSI-E vs LSI, Fig 2G-J). Paper also compares LSI-E vs Sham (Supp Fig 2A), which confounds surgery and exercise and is secondary. LSI vs Sham (surgery effect) is not exercise and only exploratory. One limma model on all 9 rat samples. All three pairwise comparisons are fitted from the same model; grp_LSI_vs_Sham (surgery effect) is exploratory, not an exercise estimand.

candidates.value: pool LSI and Sham as non-exercise control
candidates.reason_rejected: pools distinct levels; Sham did not undergo surgery

covariance.reasoning: Independent male rats, one sample each; no batch, sex or lane annotation in GEO; all rat samples on one platform (GPL24688) and one matrix.

final.method: limma (moderated t, empirical Bayes) on log2(RPKM+1)

paper_route.reason: paper reports no DEG method; only RPKM deposited

deviations: limma on log2(RPKM+1) chosen by policy because only RPKM is deposited and the paper names no DE method

method.reasoning: Matrix policy: linear normalized RPKM -> log2(x+1) then limma. Count methods would need raw counts, not deposited; RPKM is not rounded.

threshold.reasoning: Paper states no DEG threshold (only GSEA NES/p/FDR q cutoffs in S4.3.p2), so the workflow default BH-adjusted p < 0.05 with no fold-change rule is used and marked as fallback.

caveats: Paper reports no DEG method, threshold or DEG counts; the DE route (limma on log2 RPKM) and threshold (workflow default) are not reproductions of a stated paper rule.
About 10-20 gene IDs in the deposited matrix are Excel-date-mangled (e.g. 1-Mar, 15-Sep); left as deposited.

Very large DEG sets (9801 LSIE vs LSI at BH<0.05, 4735 after TPM rescaling + RPKM>=1 filter): within-group Spearman r ~0.99 vs between-group ~0.93, and LSI columns have a different RPKM distribution (max ~33k vs ~14k); consistent with group-wise library processing that GEO does not record, so group may be partly aliased with an unrecorded batch.

Pathway direction agrees with the paper: Hallmark INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE, TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB, IFN-gamma up in LSI-E vs LSI (GSEA FDR<0.001); KEGG ORA Osteoclast differentiation adj p 0.050 but Cytosolic DNA-sensing (0.70) and NF-kB (0.16) not significant by ORA on the all-direction DEG list.

study.reasoning: Contrast and sample set match the paper; comparison to the paper is at the pathway level (inflammatory response, NF-kB, cytosolic DNA sensing up in LSI-E).

discrepancies.item: GEO series contains human IVDD/Normal samples
discrepancies.paper: human NP RNA-seq used for degeneration correlation (S2.1.p3), not exercise

executions.name: joint
executions.reasoning: one limma model (~ grp) on all 9 rat samples, log2(RPKM+1); grp_LSIE_vs_LSI is the exercise estimand, grp_LSIE_vs_Sham secondary per paper, grp_LSI_vs_Sham exploratory

executions.name: joint_tpm_filt
executions.reasoning: sensitivity: RPKM column sums differ by group (LSI carries a few genes up to 33k RPKM, shifting the median); rescaling each column to sum 1e6 (TPM-equivalent) before log2 and dropping genes with RPKM<1 in fewer than 3 samples tests whether the skewed up/down balance is a composition artefact

enrichment.reasoning: paper claims GO/KEGG/GSEA inflammatory, NF-kB and cytosolic DNA-sensing activation in LSI-E vs LSI (Fig 2G-I); rat symbols on mouse sets
